The main takeaway from our work is that

there is a need to develop a new set of evaluation metrics for activity recognition in realistic scenarios, as the current metrics (i.e. accuracy and precision) are not suitable for the evaluation of activity recognition systems.

there is a need to develop a robust method for recognizing activities from continuous video streams, and to design an efficient method for searching and retrieving activities from a large video database.
